info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Ecommerce Cart Taxs-v2-spec
info.description: The Ecommerce Cart Tax Retrieval API allows applications to fetch tax information associated with a user's shopping cart. This API provides accurate tax calculations based on the items in the cart, ensuring compliance with local tax regulations. Typical consumers include ecommerce platforms and checkout systems that need to display accurate pricing information to users. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance their checkout process with real-time tax data, ultimately improving customer experience and trust.

get.summary: Retrieve the tax information for the shopping cart.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current tax details associated with the items in the user's shopping cart. It calculates the applicable taxes based on the cart's contents and the user's location.
